claims.value: Per-specimen taxon for the 8 specimens with a previously identified taxon (51 rows): Ursidae (GdC_1, R10340), Rangifer tarandus (GdC_9, R10329, R10363), Bovidae (GdC_26), Rhinocerotidae (R10300), Equidae (R10357); Mammalia for the other specimens (GdC_6 ambiguous, GdC_7 and GdC_193 not previously identified, R10359 Hyaenidae/Felinae ambiguous); bone tissue; tissue
claims.evidence: Paper Table 1 (PMC10603084): 'Taxonomic identity' per specimen, 'based on prior analysis using ZooMS (for Ranis) or SPIN (for GdC)'; reindeer = Rangifer tarandus (NCBITaxon:9870); family-level terms NCBITaxon:9632 Ursidae, 9895 Bovidae, 9803 Rhinocerotidae, 9788 Equidae resolve live. Prior-analysis identity, not a result of this dataset (the study re-identifies species from the deposited runs). README: reference database spans Mammalia; PRIDE organism part Bone

live OLS4: Mammalia NCBITaxon:40674, bone tissue UBERON:0002481, MS:1001251, MS:1001309, MS:1003028, PRIDE:0000627, PRIDE:0000609, PRIDE:0000606, MS:1000422, UNIMOD:7/27/28/35/108, blank PRIDE:0001016 (child of PRIDE:0000895)

limitations: Specimen identity for 8 files (4EDTA ID01-ID06 nt, ID01-ID02 ac) is not stated anywhere; they are labelled unmapped. They are Ranis-range IDs by position only.
disease, developmental stage, strain, sex not available (archaeological bone)
specimen identifiers, sites and ages (>50 kya GdC, 40-50 kya Ranis) are not carried by a template column
mass tolerances not stated in the deposit (MaxQuant parameters.txt tolerances at defaults, not read as explicit values)
paper numbering of methods (3 LysC, 4 protease mix) differs from file labels (3EDTA = protease mix, 4EDTA = LysC); the file names and SampletoData.csv were followed
paper states 3a, 5a and 3b-Ranis were excluded from analysis, but those RAW files are deposited and annotated

parse_sdrf cache-only errors: sample type values study sample and blank are not in the cache (both valid in live OLS4); tools check flags Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, Nethylmaleimide as hallucinated although live OLS4 resolves UNIMOD:28/27/108 with these labels

Organism values for the 8 specimens are the previously published ZooMS/SPIN identities from Table 1, not results of this dataset; specimens whose Table 1 identity is ambiguous or absent stay Mammalia. Blank rows are not applicable.

characteristics[organism] mixes taxonomic ranks (species Rangifer tarandus, families Ursidae/Bovidae/Rhinocerotidae/Equidae, class Mammalia); all are NCBITaxon terms and validate, but consumers filtering by species should be aware.
